id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

state.description: `paused`: their messages to each other are held. `going`: they carry on.

why.description: Why Chips paused them: `spend`, the room's job reached its ceiling (ADR 0118). Absent when a person did.

spend.description: For `why: spend`: what the job had spent, against what the room allows a job.

ceiling_usd.description: What the room allows a job, in US dollars: its own ceiling, or the default (3) when nobody has set one.

spent_usd.description: What the room's runs reported costing since the job began, in US dollars, every harness's together.

since_seq.description: Where the job began: the `seq` of the last thing a person did in the room, or of the last brief handed into it, whichever is later; 0 when neither has happened.

uncounted_runs.description: How many of the job's runs reported no cost, and so count nothing.

description: A person paused the agents in a room, or let them carry on; or Chips paused them at the room's spend ceiling.
title: ExchangeSet
